Narrow it to imports actually named by reached lift.* rows (the missing-invocation handling at work.pop already records those), and add a test: bound oracle/action root in an object with an unrelated pinned import reports Established for the covered owner. If a donor record ever carries both orientations (G,H) and (H,G) of one pair under one claim index and G/H order classical arg names differently, the first entry's domain function can false-reject a vector covered under the second.
